title: First AIGC Adaptation of a Wuxia Comic Film 'Shan Zhu Dao' Exclusively Launched Online: When AI Technology Meets Oriental Aesthetics
excerpt: Recently, the AIGC-adapted wuxia film "Shan Zhu Dao," based on a popular domestic wuxia comic of the same name, has officially launched exclusively on Tencent V
content_html:
Recently, the AIGC-adapted wuxia film "Shan Zhu Dao," based on a popular domestic wuxia comic of the same name, has officially launched exclusively on Tencent Video and Jiguang TV. The film focuses on the end of an era of chaos, telling the story of a female swordsman, Zhi Zhu, who once fought in the江湖 (wuxia world), experienced the death of comrades and betrayal by her sect members. After deciding to return her sect's sacred item and retire from the江湖, she unexpectedly meets a doctor, Li Xiaoruo, who is carrying an important piece of evidence. During an eight-hundred-mile perilous escort journey, the two women go from mutual suspicion at first to supporting each other in desperate situations, ultimately completing their self-redemption and growth.

The original comic was written by cartoonist Li Xiaoshan and scripted by film producer Jin Suhang. With its unique Eastern aesthetics and profound chivalric core, it won the Best Emerging Anime Award at the 22nd China Animation Golden Dragon Awards, making it a highly recognizable original Chinese-style IP.

Regarding common industry pain points in AIGC long-term content creation, such as character image deviation, emotional expression gaps, and narrative logic fragmentation, "Shan Zhu Dao" has built a complete end-to-end workflow in production. The project has fully integrated the AIGC industrial process, from script, storyboard, art, generation, editing, quality control to final delivery. By fully leveraging the efficiency value of technology, the narrative logic, character performance, and rhythm of shots have been strictly controlled, ensuring the completeness and high-quality texture required for long-form storytelling.

In terms of visual presentation and atmosphere creation, the film successfully transformed the flat wuxia aesthetics of the comic into smooth and natural dynamic imagery. The production team relied on AIGC to efficiently generate art materials and conducted detailed calibration of artistic tone and visual style throughout the process. The scene construction deeply integrated the Ming Dynasty historical background with the cultural essence of Jiangnan, skillfully incorporating elements such as ancient towns, streams, market inns, and traditional dyeing workshops into the wuxia narrative, allowing the entire wuxia work to take root in local cultural soil, combining historical depth with Eastern poetry.
